description: This file is a CMake module script defining the function `compile_aidl`. It provides functionality for generating source code from AIDL files during the build process, including parsing arguments, locating the AIDL compiler, setting options, and executing the build command.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: Defines a CMake function to generate source files from AIDL files, with options for compiler path, language, include directories, flags, and target output directory.
